articles.summary: Sanmina Corporation ("Sanmina" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: SANM), a leading integrated manufacturing solutions company, today reported financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended September 27, 2025 and outlook for its fiscal first quarter ending December 27, 2025. Fourth Quarter Fiscal 2025 Financial Highlights • Revenue: $2.1 billion • GAAP operating margin: 3.7% • GAAP diluted EPS: $0.88 • Non-GAAP(1) operating margin: 6.0% • Non-GAAP(1) diluted EPS: $1.67 Fisc
articles.title: SANMINA REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL 2025 FINANCIAL RESULTS
